## Deliverable

A single migration file `supabase/sql/fix_rls_tenant_scope.sql` (full content below). **Nothing will be applied automatically** — review it, then run it manually in Supabase SQL Editor.

## Coverage

- 100 policies across 78 tables identified by the discovery query.
- Each one currently uses `auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id'`, which Supabase does not populate. They all return `[]` to the browser.
- The migration replaces only the JWT predicate with `tenant_id IN (SELECT public.current_user_tenant_ids())`. Every other predicate (`is_public = true`, `tenant_id IS NULL OR ...`, asymmetric USING vs CHECK on `apps`, etc.) is preserved verbatim.

## Risk notes (read before running)

| Concern | Mitigation in this migration |
|---|---|
| Write policies (`INSERT`/`UPDATE`/`DELETE`/`ALL`) become "any active member can write" | This matches the *current* behavior (any holder of the matching JWT claim could write). It does **not** further restrict — but it does not weaken either. Tightening to role/ownership is a separate task. |
| `apps_tenant_isolation` USING has `OR is_public = true` but CHECK does not | Preserved exactly: USING keeps the OR, CHECK stays tenant-only. |
| `entity_schemas_tenant_isolation` allows global rows where `tenant_id IS NULL` | Preserved exactly in both USING and CHECK. |
| `tenants.tenants_read` / `tenants_update` filter by `id =` (not `tenant_id =`) | Special-cased: `id IN (SELECT public.current_user_tenant_ids())`. |
| `user_roles` had no JWT policy | Migration still adds the bootstrap self-read policy idempotently. |
| `central_users` / `tenant_memberships` already have tenant-isolation policies | Existing tenant policies are rewritten **and** a self-read policy is added so the user can bootstrap. |
| Helper function uses `SECURITY DEFINER` reading `tenant_memberships` | Locked down: `REVOKE ALL FROM PUBLIC; GRANT EXECUTE TO authenticated`. Function is `STABLE` with fixed `search_path`. |
| Performance | New composite index `(user_id, status, tenant_id)` on `tenant_memberships` covers the helper. |
| Idempotency | Helper uses `CREATE OR REPLACE`. All policies are `DROP POLICY IF EXISTS` then `CREATE POLICY`. Self-read policies use the same pattern. |
| Roll-back | Each old policy body is documented in the summary table below; you can recreate by inverting the script. |

## Summary table (table → old policy → new policy)

For brevity, the **78** tables fall into 4 shapes. Old/new bodies for each shape:

**Shape A — standard tenant_isolation ALL** (most tables)
- Old: `USING (tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid)` (CHECK null → defaults to USING)
- New: `USING (tenant_id IN (SELECT public.current_user_tenant_ids())) WITH CHECK (tenant_id IN (SELECT public.current_user_tenant_ids()))`

**Shape B — explicit USING + CHECK ALL** (capability_visibility, dynamix_*, event_subscribers, events, jarvix_*, memory_search_logs, organiser_*, policies, policy_evaluations, semantic_*, app_installations, apps, tenant_memberships, workspaces, etc.)
- Same as Shape A, both clauses explicit.

**Shape C — separate SELECT policies** (`*_read`, e.g. workspaces_read, apps_read, tenants_read)
- Old: `FOR SELECT USING (tenant_id = (auth.jwt() ->> 'tenant_id')::uuid)`
- New: `FOR SELECT USING (tenant_id IN (SELECT public.current_user_tenant_ids()))`

**Shape D — special cases (preserved predicates)**
| Policy | Preserved extra predicate |
|---|---|
| `apps.apps_tenant_isolation` | USING keeps `OR (is_public = true)` |
| `apps.apps_write` (INSERT) | CHECK only, no USING |
| `entity_schemas.entity_schemas_tenant_isolation` | both clauses keep `tenant_id IS NULL OR ...` |
| `tenants.tenants_read`, `tenants.tenants_update` | predicate on `id`, not `tenant_id` |

Full per-table list (all 100 policies) is embedded as comments in the SQL file.

## File to create: `supabase/sql/fix_rls_tenant_scope.sql`

```sql
-- =====================================================================
-- fix_rls_tenant_scope.sql
-- Replace auth.jwt()->>'tenant_id' with auth.uid()-based access via
-- public.current_user_tenant_ids(). DO NOT auto-apply. Review first.
-- Idempotent: safe to re-run.
-- =====================================================================

BEGIN;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. SECURITY DEFINER helper
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_user_tenant_ids()
RETURNS SETOF uuid
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
  SELECT tm.tenant_id
  FROM public.tenant_memberships tm
  WHERE tm.user_id = auth.uid()
    AND tm.status  = 'active'
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.current_user_tenant_ids() FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.current_user_tenant_ids() TO authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Supporting index
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tenant_memberships_user_status_tenant
  ON public.tenant_memberships (user_id, status, tenant_id);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. Bootstrap self-read policies (additive)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS central_users_self_read ON public.central_users;
CREATE POLICY central_users_self_read
  ON public.central_users FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (id = auth.uid());

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_memberships_self_read ON public.tenant_memberships;
CREATE POLICY tenant_memberships_self_read
  ON public.tenant_memberships FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (user_id = auth.uid());

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS user_roles_self_read ON public.user_roles;
CREATE POLICY user_roles_self_read
  ON public.user_roles FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (user_id = auth.uid());

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. Rewrite JWT-based tenant policies
--    Pattern A: ALL with USING only -> USING + WITH CHECK both = helper
--    Pattern B: ALL with USING + CHECK -> rewrite both = helper
--    Pattern C: SELECT only -> rewrite USING = helper
--    Pattern D: special predicates preserved verbatim (see end)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Helper macro (manual): every standard ALL policy below uses
--   USING (tenant_id IN (SELECT public.current_user_tenant_ids()))
--   WITH CHECK (tenant_id IN (SELECT public.current_user_tenant_ids()))

-- access_rights
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS access_rights_tenant_isolation ON public.access_rights;
CREATE POLICY access_rights_tenant_isolation ON public.access_rights
  FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING (tenant_id IN (SELECT public.current_user_tenant_ids()))
  WITH CHECK (tenant_id IN (SELECT public.current_user_tenant_ids()));

-- agent_runs
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON public.agent_runs;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON public.agent_runs
  FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING (tenant_id IN (SELECT public.current_user_tenant_ids()))
  WITH CHECK (tenant_id IN (SELECT public.current_user_tenant_ids()));
```
